title: Jardin oo Hunaama e Fajiri
intro: E waktuuji deeƴɗi hade naange fuɗde, peeje mbaɗaama e nder sirlu. Ndonu ɓuuɓngu ina darii ina heddii e dañde, kono pellital ina waɗa ngam woɗɗinde kala lekki e ŋakkiraaɓe. Subaka fof, huunde fof ina wayi no anndaaka, janngo ina 6eydoo 6uu6de e calcfi ɓaleeji wonande miijotoo6e fof.
clues: En ndokkii gesa ɓuuɓɗo, en kuniima ƴettude ɓiɓɓe mum fof ngam koye men.
Min kuniima yaltude fajiri law tawi miskineeɓe naamnotooɓe geɗal mum en ina ɗaanii.
En njaltinii kala ko seerti e hunnde men, en ndartinii hakke miskineeɓe tawa en mbiyaani so Alla jaɓii.
Min njalti min njuurondira ngam haɗde miskiino gooto naatde e jarne amen ñalnde heen.
En cikkatnoo koye men ina mbaawi mooftude kala ko ina haɗa kala ƴattoowo ƴettude heen geɗal.
Min ngummii min tawi gesa amen ina boni e jamma, ina ɓalee no feewi, min mbiyi min ŋakkiraama min tuubnii.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
